mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( user_id, service_id, reservation_start, status, request_memo ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{serviceId}, #{reservationStart}, #{status}, #{requestMemo} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.service_id, r.reservation_start, r.status, r.request_memo, r.created_at, u.name AS user_name, s.name AS service_name, s.price AS service_price, s.duration_minutes FROM reservation r INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN service_item s ON s.id = r.service_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.reservation_start DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.service_id, r.reservation_start, r.status, r.request_memo, r.created_at, u.name AS user_name, s.name AS service_name, s.price AS service_price, s.duration_minutes FROM reservation r INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN service_item s ON s.id = r.service_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
